jobs.description:
Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful business impact? Do you enjoy collaborating with others to solve complex challenges and building modern data platforms that enable better decisions?

At Valcon, we're growing our Data & AI community and are looking for a Data Engineer who combines technical curiosity with a collaborative mindset. We are particularly interested in professionals with strong Databricks and AWS experience who want to help shape innovative data solutions for some of Denmark's leading organisations.

The role

As an experienced Data Engineer at Valcon, you'll work closely with clients, architects, data scientists, and fellow engineers to design, build, and use scalable cloud-based data platforms. You will play a key role in helping organisations transform data into insights, AI solutions, and business value. A significant part of the role will involve working with Databricks and AWS, designing modern data platforms, building robust data pipelines, implementing modern AI/BI tooling, and supporting clients throughout their transformation journeys. Depending on the project, you'll also work with technologies such as Azure, Python, SQL, Terraform, and PySpark.

What you bring along

• Minimum of 5 years of experience building and using modern data platforms based on Databricks and AWS

• Preferably fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken

• Strong data engineering skills, including data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data modelling

• Familiar with engineering best practices, CI/CD, DevOps, testing, and automation

• Experience from regulated industries such as Life Sciences, Financial Services, Tax Administration, or Defence is an advantage

• A collaborative mindset with a passion for solving complex challenges and creating impact together with clients and colleagues

Why join Valcon?

At Valcon, you'll become part of a collaborative and welcoming community where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development are a natural part of everyday life. We offer exciting projects, a transparent career framework, certification opportunities, and strong support for your professional growth. We also believe that great work happens when people thrive, which is why we place a strong emphasis on flexibility, well-being, and family-friendly benefits. Beyond our client work, our community comes together through both professional and social activities, creating an environment where people can build meaningful relationships and feel a sense of belonging.

Interested?

We are looking for talented professionals who are excited by this opportunity and can contribute to our team. While you may not meet every requirement, you should bring strong relevant experience and a genuine passion for data and technology. We invite candidates ongoing to interviews.

Leading the commissioning strategy, team and schedule from mobilisation to integrated systems testing.

**Role Overview

**The Commissioning Manager leads Sensori's commissioning function on a project, ensuring mechanical and electrical systems are started, tested and proven safely, in the right sequence and to the client's acceptance criteria. The role develops the commissioning plan and schedule, manages commissioning engineers and vendor resources, controls the interface with the client's commissioning agent, and integrates commissioning requirements into the construction program so that handover is predictable and fully documented.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities

**

• Develop and own the project commissioning plan, including strategy, organisation, level definitions, sequences, acceptance criteria and documentation requirements.

• Build and maintain the commissioning schedule; integrate it with the construction program and drive readiness of systems and areas to support it.

• Lead, allocate and develop the team of commissioning engineers; coordinate vendor and subcontractor commissioning resources.

• Chair commissioning coordination meetings with construction, quality, Authorised Persons, vendors and the client's commissioning agent.

• Oversee development and approval of method statements, checklists, test scripts and integrated systems test procedures.

• Manage the energisation and start-up sequence in conjunction with the Senior Authorised Person, ensuring permits, isolations and safety controls are in place.

• Monitor test execution, witness critical tests and ensure results are recorded, reviewed and accepted in the commissioning management system.

• Manage the commissioning issues log; drive closure of deficiencies with construction teams, subcontractors and vendors.

• Plan and lead integrated systems testing, including failure scenarios and redundancy demonstrations, with the client and third parties.

• Ensure complete, accurate turnover packages, training and documentation are delivered for handover.

• Report commissioning progress, risks and constraints to project leadership weekly; contribute to lessons learned and improvement of Sensori's commissioning standards.

• Support pre-construction and tenders with commissioning strategies, durations and resource plans.

**Selection criteria / person specification

**

• Degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Building Services Engineering, or a trade qualification with extensive commissioning leadership experience.

• At least seven years in commissioning, including several years leading commissioning teams on data centre, pharmaceutical or mission-critical projects.

• Strong understanding of both mechanical and electrical systems, sequences of operation and integrated testing.

• Experience working with client commissioning agents and formal level-based commissioning processes.

• Proven ability to plan and schedule commissioning within a construction program and to manage readiness across trades.

• Familiarity with commissioning management software and structured documentation.

• Strong leadership, coordination and communication skills; able to chair meetings and influence senior stakeholders.

• Sound knowledge of safe systems of work for energisation and live testing.

• Willing to travel and to be site-based for extended periods.

Location: Aarhus, Hamburg, Malaga, Oslo or Copenhagen

Type: Hybrid & Full-time

About the Job

We are looking for a Senior Security Architect to shape and strengthen security across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services. You will join a small, senior architecture team at the center of Stibo DX's transformation from self-hosted and hybrid deployments to a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a hands-on, embedded role. You will work with engineering, product, platform, operations, customer-facing teams, and legal to ensure security is built into our solutions by design, not added afterwards. You will turn security strategy and risk into practical architecture, reusable patterns, and controls that teams can implement.

Your goal is to establish a consistent security architecture across Stibo DX and give teams clear standards, patterns, and guardrails to make secure architecture decisions. Early priorities will include establishing a security architecture baseline, identifying key security gaps across our SaaS platform, strengthening security architecture reviews and threat modelling, and defining reusable security patterns for engineering teams.

The role is primarily focused on security architecture, product and platform security, and secure engineering practices. You will also drive the technical aspects of security governance and support compliance activities when needed, including security certifications, customer security requirements, regulatory obligations, risk assessments, policies, and audit preparation.

You will work alongside peer architects covering Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration, reporting to the Director of Solution Architecture. Our governance model is based on minimum necessary control: decisions close to teams, with oversight proportional to risk and impact.

Security remains a shared responsibility. The Senior Security Architect owns the security architecture direction, standards, patterns, and cross-cutting guidance, while Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration architects continue to consider and address security within their respective domains. Engineering teams remain responsible for implementing and operating the required controls.

What You'll Do

• Define security architecture strategy across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services, including principles, standards, target architectures, guardrails, and roadmaps.

• Embed secure-by-design practices into product discovery, solution design, delivery, and operation, working with teams early rather than reviewing security only at the end.

• Lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product, platform, customer, and technology initiatives; identify risks and align on practical mitigation with accountable teams.

• Shape identity and access management covering authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access, service identities, secrets, and Zero Trust principles.

• Strengthen cloud and platform security for AWS, Kubernetes, networks, workloads, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data, and shared SaaS platform capabilities.

• Define reusable security patterns and controls for APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, encryption, key management, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.

• Embed security in the software development lifecycle by defining practices and guardrails and helping teams integrate security into engineering practices, automation, architecture decision records, and delivery pipelines.

• Lead security governance and compliance work when needed including security policies, control design, risk assessments, evidence coordination, audit preparation, and remediation planning.

• Translate external requirements into technical action including customer security expectations, contractual commitments, privacy requirements, and relevant frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CRA.

• Raise security maturity across Stibo DX through coaching, practical guidance, cross-team collaboration, and clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 10+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud/platform engineering, or cybersecurity, with 4+ years in a senior security architecture or technical security leadership role.

• Proven experience designing and securing cloud-native, distributed, and microservices-based systems in production.

• Practical experience with SaaS and multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, identity, data protection, and shared platform controls.

• Experience leading threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and remediation planning across multiple teams or product areas.

• Experience defining security standards, patterns, reference architectures, and governance that teams can apply in practice.

• Experience working with security and compliance frameworks and translating them into proportionate technical and organizational controls.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineers, architects, product leaders, operations, customers, legal, and senior stakeholders.

Technical expertise

• Cloud security, preferably AWS, and Kubernetes/container security.

• Identity and Access Management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, federation, privileged access, and service identities.

• Application, API, integration, and event-driven security.

• Network security, workload protection, secrets management, encryption, certificates, and key management.

• Secure software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD security, and software supply-chain security.

• Security logging, monitoring, detection capabilities, vulnerability management, and incident preparedness.

• Threat modelling, security risk analysis, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles.

Nice to have

• Experience leading or materially supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR security controls, CRA, or similar initiatives.

• Experience with enterprise customer security assessments, contractual security requirements, and audit evidence coordination.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience helping an organization establish or mature a security architecture and governance capability.

Personal qualities

• Hands-on and credible with engineers, while able to communicate security clearly with product, customers, legal, and leadership.

• Pragmatic and risk-based: able to balance security, usability, operational complexity, cost, and delivery speed without compromising critical controls.

• Collaborative and influential, using expertise, evidence, and trust rather than creating unnecessary gates.

• Structured and decisive, able to make risks, responsibilities, and architectural decisions explicit.

• Curious, adaptable, and motivated by building long-term security maturity while helping teams deliver now.

What We Offer

• Real influence on the security foundations of Stibo DX's cloud-native SaaS transformation.

• Ownership of security architecture and a central role in shaping security governance and compliance maturity.

• Hands-on work on real product, platform, customer, and operational challenges, not security from an ivory tower.

• A small, senior architecture team with trust, autonomy, and meaningful responsibility.

• High visibility across product, engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, legal, and leadership.

• The opportunity to create reusable security practices and patterns with lasting impact across Stibo DX.

Interested?

Apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

For any questions, please reach out to hiring manager Safdar Aqeel Safdar on safs@stibodx.com.

You will combine naval architecture expertise with hands-on project management, steering complex newbuilding activities from early design and specification through construction and delivery.

Maersk is transforming its fleet through new technologies, new fuels and ambitious requirements for safety, efficiency and sustainability. You will join Fleet Technology in Copenhagen and work directly with shipyards, designers, classification societies, equipment makers, site teams and specialists across Maersk.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration and continuous learning, and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

About the role

This is a project delivery role with a strong naval architecture foundation. You will lead and coordinate engineering work across disciplines, turn technical findings into clear recommendations and help mature key matters towards timely project decisions. Your judgement will influence vessels from the drawing board until they enter service.

What you will do

• Lead naval architecture and newbuilding project activities from concept development and specification through detailed design, construction and delivery.

• Plan, coordinate and follow up engineering activities, interfaces, risks and decisions across project teams, shipyards and site offices.

• Drive design reviews, plan approval topics, technical evaluations and trade-off studies with internal and external partners.

• Continuously challenge how we can make our vessels safer, smarter, more efficient and more sustainable.

• Support and share knowledge with colleagues in a collaborative environment with flat team structures and a strong sense of shared ownership.

What we are looking for

• A degree in Naval Architecture and 5+ years of relevant experience in ship design, newbuilding or maritime engineering.

• Proven project management experience from ship newbuilding or major conversion projects, gained with a shipowner, shipyard, designer, consultancy or classification society.

jobs.occupation: Data Center Facilities Technician II, Electrical
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of electrical experience (e.g., electrical testing equipment or electrical distribution) in industrial or commercial environment.

• Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.

• Ability to work non-standard hours and work rotations/shifts.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.

• Experience in electrical maintenance in critical large scale facilities (Data Center, Pharma, Medical or Electrical) including UPS, generators, LV/MV switchgear Strong electrical safety awareness and ability to develop switching procedures and RAMS.

• Knowledge of electrical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, ATS/STS units, PDU/PMM units).

• Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.

• Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

**About The Job

**The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. **About Kanpla

**Kanpla helps contract caterers create better dining experiences while cutting food waste. What started as a school project now serves more than 800,000 users across 5,000+ locations in 14 countries.

We're a team of 70+ and are growing aggressively across both Europe, UK & the US.

Our revenue comes from three places: software subscriptions, card payments on our platform, and the hardware and services we sell alongside our software. All of that runs through three legal entities (Denmark, the UK and the US) and three accounting systems. That's a lot of moving parts. So far, our VP of Finance has built and run the accounting setup, with support from our external partner ScaleUp Finance. As we grow, we want a dedicated person to take full ownership of the accounting & monthly close. That's where you come in.

**About The Role

**This is an ownership role. You'll be responsible and accountable for Kanpla's accounting function: the close, the numbers and the processes behind them.

The setup is up and running today, so you won't be starting from scratch. Our VP of Finance will onboard you and hand over the accounting, so you can take full ownership as quickly as possible. From there, the function is yours to run. ScaleUp handles day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll and VAT for our Danish parent company, and Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, supports you on the daily tasks.

Your job is to make sure everything going into the books is complete and correct, and that everything coming out of them is accurate and on time. Over time, we want to bring more of the work in-house and use external partners where it actually makes sense. You'll drive that, together with our VP of Finance.

You'll own finance operations end to end: what we invoice, what we collect, what we pay, what we pay our people, how we close the books and what we owe in VAT. That covers Denmark (e-conomic), the UK (Xero) and the US (QuickBooks).

We're also tidying up our structure across countries and investing heavily in automation, AI and data across the company, including a move to a new group-wide accounting / ERP system down the line. So there's plenty to build, not just to maintain.

This is a hands-on role, not a pure reporting job. You'll be accountable for making sure our numbers can be trusted, and you'll keep improving the processes behind them.

What you'll do

• Run the group close (monthly, quarterly and year-end) and lock the numbers on time, reviewing ScaleUp Finance's work along the way.

• Own AR and AP end to end: invoicing, collections, bank reconciliation and supplier payments.

• Make sure revenue matches across CRM, billing and accounting.

• Own VAT reporting across our markets, working with our external advisers.

• Manage payroll in Denmark, the UK and the US, including Employer of Record setups.

• Keep hardware margins on budget and sales in line with Incoterms and VAT, together with our Head of Hardware.

• Prepare financial statements and support budgeting and variance analysis.

• Be the main point of contact for our auditors.

• Keep improving controls and processes, and cut manual work.

What you'll bring

There's more than one route into this role. Strong candidates will probably bring most of the following:

• 4+ years in accounting or finance or finance operations, in a growing international company or an audit or accounting firm.

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, as our parent company operates under Danish law.

• Hands-on experience owning a month-end close, ideally with an external accounting partner.

• Solid AR, AP and European VAT experience.

• Experience with e-conomic, Xero or QuickBooks, and the confidence to learn the others fast.

• Precision with reconciliations, and the habit of finding the root cause.

• The judgement to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

• Clear written English.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience from an international scale-up.

• Payroll experience, ideally across countries.

• UK or US accounting (or you'll pick it up on the job).

• ERP implementation or migration experience.

• Experience with hardware or Incoterms.

• Danish language skills.

What we offer

• Real ownership, with a direct line to the VP of Finance.

• A broad role across three countries, software, hardware, payments and payroll.

• The chance to shape our finance function, and grow with it.

• A competitive salary and real support for your development.

• Remote-first working and two off-sites or workcations a year.

Practical details

This is a full-time, permanent role, ideally based in Copenhagen, where our VP of Finance and the rest of the finance team sit. It covers our entities in Denmark, the UK and the US.

You'll report to Felix, our VP of Finance, and be part of a small finance team that also includes Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, who helps with accounts receivable, accounts payable, VAT and billing. Day to day, you'll work with Customer Success, Sales and Operations on invoicing and collections, and with our Head of Hardware on hardware. Externally, you'll work with ScaleUp, our auditors, tax advisers, payroll and Employer of Record providers, and payment partners.

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to fill the role as soon as possible.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. **Traits and mindset

A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

jobs.description:
Are you a senior backend engineer who wants to combine hands-on development with technical leadership, cloud architecture and operational responsibility?

For our client Lattec, we are looking for a hands-on Backend Tech Lead / SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) to help shape, build and operate their AWS-based backend platform. This is a key technical role in Lattec’s R&D Software organisation, where you will provide day-to-day technical leadership within the backend/SRE domain while remaining close to the code, architecture and production systems.

Lattec, based in Allerød, Denmark, has achieved significant international success with its advanced solutions for modern dairy farming. The company develops proactive analytical and sensor systems that monitor the health of dairy cows on farms, serving customers worldwide. Lattec has a strong multidisciplinary team of approx. 60 employees, around 30 in R&D including software developers, hardware, electronics and mechanical engineers, as well as chemical engineers, veterinarians and biologists.

The role as Backend Tech Lead / SRE

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the backend/SRE domain and translate overall technical direction into daily engineering execution. You will guide backend developers, contribute directly to development and strengthen the reliability, observability and operational maturity of the platform.

Lattec’s Tech Leads collaborate closely across Device, Backend/SRE and Frontend, recognising cross-team collaboration as essential to sharing priorities, managing dependencies and aligning technical decisions. This ensures a common direction and helps identify integration risks early.

What you will do

• Lead the day-to-day technical work within the backend/SRE domain.

• Actively contribute to backend development and remain close to the code and technology.

• Provide technical direction, support architectural decisions and help resolve complex technical challenges.

• Take technical ownership of SRE, reliability, observability and operability.

• Improve monitoring, incident handling, CI/CD, automation and deployment practices.

• Drive good engineering practices, code quality, maintainability and documentation.

• Work with AWS-based backend technologies, focusing on scalable, secure and reliable solutions.

• Work closely with the R&D Software Lead to translate overall R&D priorities into clear backend/SRE priorities, ensuring that incoming tasks are understood, assessed and handled in line with the wider R&D direction.

Tech stack and your experience

We expect you to bring strong, hands-on experience with several of the core technologies used in the AWS backend platform, including:

• Python for backend services, automation, data processing and AWS Lambda development.

• TypeScript for modern backend services, tooling, infrastructure definitions and integrations where relevant.

• AWS Lambda and serverless architecture, including event-driven design, scalability, security and operational robustness.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform or similar tools, to ensure repeatable and maintainable cloud infrastructure.

• GraphQL for new APIs, including schema design, resolver implementation, API versioning, performance considerations and alignment with frontend consumers.

• AWS services commonly used in backend platforms, such as API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch and IAM.

• CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation and production monitoring in an AWS environment.

About you

You are a senior backend engineer who enjoys combining hands-on development with technical leadership. You are comfortable making technical decisions, guiding other developers and taking responsibility for systems that need to run reliably in production.

You likely bring:

• Strong backend engineering experience, preferably in cloud-native or serverless environments.

• A practical understanding of SRE, observability and operating production systems.

• Experience designing APIs and integrations, ideally using GraphQL.

• A pragmatic approach to guiding technical decisions, fostering open collaboration and keeping momentum high.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work across frontend, backend and device boundaries.

• A focus on quality, security and maintainable solutions.

Fluency in English and Danish is essential.

What makes this role different

This is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. You lead through technical expertise, collaboration and active involvement in development, staying close to the code while providing the direction needed to ensure the backend/SRE domain evolves in line with the wider platform.

The Lattec mindset

• Be curious, experiment and take pride in making things work better.

• Ask “What is the system actually doing?” — not just “Is this a software problem?”

• Work across disciplines and take responsibility for the whole solution.

• Deliver precise data that helps farmers make better decisions.

• Build reliable systems that reduce downtime and give peace of mind.

• Make advanced technology simple, so customers get the value without the hassle.

Why join Lattec?

At Lattec, you will work on technology that supports modern dairy farming and contributes to better animal welfare through advanced digital solutions. You will join a focused engineering environment where backend, frontend and device development work closely together to create robust and scalable products.

If you want a hands-on technical leadership role where you can strengthen connected device development and bridge software and hardware, this could be the right opportunity for you!

For our client Lattec, we are looking for a hands-on Device Tech Lead to help shape, build and integrate software for connected devices and embedded systems. This is a key technical role in Lattec’s R&D Software organisation, where you will provide day-to-day technical leadership within the Device domain while staying close to the code, hardware and architecture.

Lattec, based in Allerød, Denmark, has achieved significant international success with its advanced solutions for modern dairy farming. The company develops proactive analytical and sensor systems that monitor the health of dairy cows on farms, serving customers worldwide. Lattec has a strong multidisciplinary team of approximately 60 employees, around 30 of whom work in R&D, including software developers, hardware, electronics and mechanical engineers, as well as chemical engineers, veterinarians and biologists.

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Device domain and translate overall technical direction into daily engineering execution. You will guide device software developers, contribute directly to development and strengthen the reliability, maintainability and integration of connected devices.

Lattec’s Tech Leads collaborate closely across Device, Backend/SRE and Frontend, recognising cross-team collaboration as essential to sharing priorities, managing dependencies and aligning technical decisions. This ensures a common direction and helps identify integration risks early.

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 6+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

• One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of up to £80,000 per year (or local equivalent).

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

**As Associate Project Portfolio Manager, you will give Novo’s investment (CAPEX) projects the overview they need to move forward. Working across projects rather than inside one, you will make sure governance is followed, turn project data into clear dashboards and visuals, and spot obstacles early. Your work supports the teams decisions at every gate, helps project managers deliver, and keeps investments in production capacity on track for people who rely on Novo’s treatments.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Experience from project coordination, project support or a junior or associate project role, or from a finance setting that follows investment projects, with a clear understanding of what it means to work to a defined project model.

• Comfort with numbers: you enjoy collecting, checking and consolidating schedules, budgets and forecasts, and presenting them in Excel and PowerPoint in a way others can act on.

• A structured, systematic way of working. You like seeing how systems and processes fit together, and you tackle problems with method rather than improvisation.

• The persistence to stay with a task until it is finished, month after month, and keep the routine running.

• The ability to influence without formal authority and to explain complex topics clearly to different stakeholders.

• Relevant education in engineering, business administration, finance, project management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience as an Associate Project Manager.

• Experience with CAPEX or other investment projects.

• A track record of creating overviews of complex systems and processes.

• Manufacturing or regulated-industry experience, including awareness of GxP, and project management training.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the managers right hand in project governance, working across the investment portfolio to make progress visible and decisions easier.

• Support the gatekeeper role by checking that deliverables for each project gate are in place, of the right quality and on time, and that decision material is ready for approval.

• Collect, consolidate and quality-check schedules, budgets, forecasts and status updates with project managers and Finance.

• Build dashboards and visuals that show priorities, budgets, milestones, risks and dependencies, so the manager can quickly judge whether a project is ready to move on.

• Anticipate obstacles across projects, such as shared resources, overlapping timelines and dependencies, and support project managers before they become problems.

• Connect project managers who are at similar stages or share equipment or resources, so they can help each other and align early.

• Prepare analyses and scenarios for the half-yearly portfolio prioritisation, and improve templates, reporting and working practices with the team.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join a Project Management Office for investment projects in Global Manufacturing & Supply, where colleagues work across the value chain to scale and deliver Novo products for the people who need them. The office is responsible for executing investment projects at a finished product site and for managing the portfolio, including which projects to prioritise and whether resources are in place to deliver them.

You will report to Sebastian, who leads a team of 15 and acts as gatekeeper for governance in project management. You will work side by side with them and present your analyses together. Your closest partners will be the project managers, project owners and sponsors, and Finance and controlling colleagues. You will also draw on input from site management, engineering, operations and Quality, and prepare material for the leadership forums that approve each gate.

The role is a stepping stone. By seeing how projects run and how the factory works, you can grow towards portfolio manager or project manager.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real responsibility from the start, with a hiring manager who wants to develop you and share what they know. You will learn how investment projects are governed and delivered, build skills across portfolio management, project controls and data visualisation, and get a close view of how a production site works. Your voice will be heard, and your ideas for improving how the PMO works will be welcome.

Expect clear performance expectations, honest feedback and colleagues who share knowledge and help each other grow.
